technical_and_design_decisions: Use AWS EC2 for AMI creation with pre-installed Kafka and Java 17+ packages.
Implement load generator and sink modules using Spring Integration and Kafka client libraries.
Configure CI builds for Windows using Jenkins with Docker-based agents for isolation.
Adopt GitHub Pages with Jekyll for static site generation to host collateral.
Leverage existing Spring XD codebase for offset management fixes in Kafka source module.
Use Lattice/Diego APIs for POC integration, focusing on SPI design for modularity.
assumptions: Development team has prior experience with Spring Framework, Kafka, and AWS.
Existing CI infrastructure (e.g., Jenkins) is available for Windows build configuration.
Kafka source module offset issue is a known bug with a documented fix path.
Performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) are already integrated into the project.
GitHub Pages setup will use a pre-configured Jekyll template for rapid deployment.
Lattice/Diego POC will focus on core SPI design without full production implementation.
